item.content:encoded: On October 29, 2026, a trojanized version (2.1.313) of the official Claude Code VS Code extension was published to Cursor's extension marketplace, reaching up to 5,000 Cursor users during an 11-hour window. item.title: How Vercel Agent accesses production safely | Vercel News
item.description: An agent working on production systems needs permission to act. A request like “fix this deployment” doesn’t tell you upfront which actions it will take or what access it will need. Grant agents broad
item.content:encoded: An agent working on production systems needs permission to act. A request like “fix this deployment” doesn’t tell you upfront which actions it will take or what access it will need. Grant agents broad access and a mistake can affect unrelated resources. Ask for approval at every step and the user has to approve individual actions before they know how the agent intends to solve the problem. Repeated prompts can turn that review into a habit of clicking approve. starts by investigating the problem
